_what: The models this computer serves, read by read-data/models-on-this-computer.mjs (tool:ask-a-model and tool:get-free-models). A conversation ({ messages }) goes to the first `chat` row whose server answers, in the OpenAI chat-completions shape (Ollama serves it; keep_alive is how long the server keeps the model loaded after a call, so the next one does not wait for it to load); `jobs` name, for a kind of work, the chat rows to try and its token limit, time limit and answer format (`default` when the input names no job). A yes-or-no question about some words ({ state, questions }) goes to the first `classify` row that answers: a small classifier taking { state, questions } and answering probabilities, or, for a row whose `ask` is "chat", a chat model asked each question with the row's `prompt` and its probability of answering yes read from its own word probabilities (yesShare). `wired` maps a decision that was measured to the one classify row that answers it. A server that is not running is skipped; none answering is said in words. Nothing leaves this computer but the answer. `server` is the local model server (Ollama): `models` lists what it has, `pull` gets a model by its name (an Ollama name, or a Hugging Face model as hf.co/<repo>:<quantisation>). `offer` are the models offered for this computer by tool:get-free-models: each with the job it does, how much memory it needs to run well (min_memory_gb) and its download size; a model fits when the computer has that memory and the size plus `disk_spare_gb` free. Its `model` names match the `chat` and `classify` rows, so a model got here answers at once. A new local server or model is a row here.

classify.prompt: Answer with one word: yes or no.
classify._measured: 2026-10-05 on 24 spoken requests (send, text, tell, call, book, remind, buy, order, pay, schedule, find, note, ask someone to) and 40 lines heard in a room (TV, chatter, cheering, fragments): 24 of 24 and 0 of 40, about 1.8 s a line while the Mac was busy; decider-2b on the same lines could not separate them (requests from 0.30, room lines up to 0.39, moving between repeats).

offer.job: Quick answers and checks on any Mac
Careful answers, and telling requests from room chatter

words.none: No model on this computer answered in time.
words.too_big: This Mac does not have the memory or free space for it.
words.not_offered: That model is not one offered for this Mac.
words.no_server: The model server is not running on this computer. Download it from ollama.com, open it, and ask again.
words.needs_input: Give messages (a conversation) or state and questions (a question about some words).
